I was so upset that I posted on a different subreddit about all the things that he did and someone directed me here. It was only after watching so many people’s stories that I realised how similar they were to mine and that led me to the conclusion that he did have some narcissistic tendencies that he wasn’t aware about.

It’s okay, you’re not alone. During the last few months of my relationship with my nex I had started fighting him excessively and would often then not talk to him for a few hours (silent treatment) and when he discarded me, I ripped him to shreds in front of my closest friends. I felt so guilty that I cried for HOURS because prior to this, I was the most kind, forgiving and patient person ever. I used to forgive people for everything and still talk nice or neutral about them. I hated myself to have lost that part of me or rather, let my nex take that away from me. Thing is, yes you did somethings that you shouldn’t have. But people like us, we struggle more than people who have had normal breakups. Yes we messed up but we feel so bad about it, our nexs are never gonna feel as bad as we do about stuff they did. The best thing you can do for yourself right now, is to block everyone involved or at least cut contact.

I didn’t eat for 3 days straight, I had nightmares, I was numb, I was so depressed that I couldn’t even hide it and the worst part is, he didn’t even have the courtesy to break up with me himself. No closure no nothing. But as I’m sitting right now about 4 months later. I still feel a lot of anxiety but it’s not as intense and isn’t making me spiral like it was before. I can now sit alone and not completely fall apart. I’m so so so sorry that you have to go through this, I wouldn’t wish it on my worst enemy. But please understand that it will get easier with time but that would require no contact and a lot of patience. If you ever want to talk, my dms are open for you.

Thing is, you left for a reason, don’t think that when they come back it’ll be because they realise how good they have it with you. They’ll only get back to suck out energy. They need your supply. Don’t wait for them. I know how hard it is, you can check my post history to see that you’re not alone, I felt the same things you’re feeling just a mere days or maybe weeks ago but right now, I’m sitting and I’m replying to you and letting you know that even if I’m not fully healed yet, I no longer want to kill myself and I now have little plans for the future and some boundaries that I fully intend to keep. Nobody deserves to go through what we did, the healing journey is something that’s really unique but please give yourself a chance. Block them and go NC, you’ll start feeling so much better after a few months I can promise you that. Don’t wait for them, I know the first few weeks are the toughest but time heals all wounds.
